tickets.title: Freeze the six-platform performance and memory measurement protocol
tickets.objective: Turn the approved thresholds into an executable predeclared workload, lifecycle and measurement specification.
deliverables: Versioned benchmark manifest and measurement/reporting protocol
Tracked timing harness with a bounded calibration tracer
acceptance_criteria: Every workload is assigned before results to compile, ordinary search, ordinary capture, ordinary replacement, complex syntax or Unicode; short, large and high-backtracking obligations have explicit applicable bins.

The accepted time gates remain 1.5x for ordinary search/capture/replacement and 2x for compile/complex/Unicode; engine working memory remains at most 2x corresponding Boost working memory plus 65536 bytes.

Inputs, requested outputs, compile/match lifecycle, reuse, result retention, memory domains, warmup, interleaving, batch count/duration, estimator, noise/outlier rules and timeout handling are fixed before acceptance measurements.
Input/output/shared-data allocations and native allocations are separately attributed; RSS or total host RAM alone is not labeled engine working memory.
Every platform/workload is judged separately; averaging cannot hide a failure and failed workloads cannot be reclassified after measurement.

Unapproved historical proposals, including a +256 KiB output-memory gate or particular fuzz/timing batch budgets, are not promoted to requirements. Any additional metric is clearly informational or separately decided.
